Test case Name: Verify Excess underlying insurance fields are text inputs
Description: Verify the three underlying-insurance limit fields and Other Limit liability field render as text inputs in an Excess submission.
Actions: 1. Sign in to EzDocs | 2. Select EzDocs Liability | 3. Search for a valid submission and select Get Submission | 4. Review Submission Details and select Next | 5. Select Excess on Information, complete mandatory fields, and continue to Coverages | 6. Inspect Occurrence Limit, Other Aggregate Limit, and Products-Completed Operations Aggregate Limit | 7. Inspect Limit of Liability in an Other Limit row
Expected Results: 1. Sign-in succeeds | 2. EzDocs Liability is selected | 3. The requested submission is loaded | 4. Submission details are displayed and the workflow advances | 5. Excess is selected and the Coverages screen is reached | 6. All three Underlying Insurance fields are text inputs | 7. Limit of Liability in the Other Limit row is a text input

Test case Name: Enter currency and limit in all underlying insurance fields
Description: Verify all three Underlying Insurance fields accept and retain a valid currency and limit, including a supported currency different from the policy currency.
Actions: 1. Navigate through EzDocs Liability to Coverages for an Excess submission | 2. Record the policy currency | 3. Enter valid currency-and-limit values in Occurrence Limit, Other Aggregate Limit, and Products-Completed Operations Aggregate Limit using the configured input syntax | 4. Use a supported non-policy currency in at least one field | 5. Move focus away from each field
Expected Results: 1. Coverages displays the Excess Underlying Insurance fields | 2. The policy currency is known for comparison | 3. Each field accepts its valid currency-and-limit entry | 4. The non-policy currency is not replaced by the policy currency | 5. Each field displays its complete entered currency and amount without truncation or removal

Test case Name: Enter currency and limit in Other Limit liability
Description: Verify Limit of Liability in an Other Limit row accepts and retains a valid currency and amount.
Actions: 1. Navigate through EzDocs Liability to Coverages for an Excess submission | 2. Add or select an applicable row in Other Limit | 3. Enter a valid currency-and-limit value using the configured input syntax | 4. Move focus away from the field
Expected Results: 1. The Other Limit row is available | 2. Limit of Liability is a text input | 3. The field accepts the valid currency and amount | 4. The complete value remains displayed and is not replaced by the policy currency

Test case Name: Keep values independent across limit fields and rows
Description: Verify entering or editing one limit does not change other Underlying Insurance fields or other Other Limit rows.
Actions: 1. Navigate to Excess Coverages | 2. Enter distinct valid currency-and-limit values in all three Underlying Insurance fields | 3. Enter distinct valid values in two Other Limit rows | 4. Edit the value in one Underlying Insurance field | 5. Recheck the other two fields and both Other Limit rows
Expected Results: 1. Coverages displays the required fields | 2. Each field retains its own distinct value | 3. Each row retains its own distinct value | 4. The edited field reflects the new value | 5. All other fields and rows remain unchanged

Test case Name: Preserve entered limits when navigating and retrieving submission
Description: Verify currency-and-limit values are preserved when progressing through the workflow and saving or retrieving the submission.
Actions: 1. Navigate to Excess Coverages in EzDocs Liability | 2. Enter valid distinct values in the three Underlying Insurance fields and an Other Limit row | 3. Save or continue the submission using the normal application workflow | 4. Navigate away from Coverages and return, or retrieve the saved submission as supported | 5. Compare each field and row with the original values
Expected Results: 1. Coverages is displayed | 2. All values are accepted and displayed | 3. The submission is saved or advanced successfully | 4. The saved submission can be reopened or Coverages revisited | 5. Every currency and amount matches its original value and remains associated with the correct field or row

Test case Name: Reject malformed currency-and-limit entry without altering other fields

Enter an invalid currency-and-limit string that violates the configured input rules in one limit field | 4. Trigger the field or form validation | 5. Review the message and recheck the invalid field and unaffected values
Expected Results: 1. Coverages is displayed with known valid values in unaffected fields | 2. The invalid value is entered for validation | 3. Validation clearly identifies the invalid entry and explains that it must be corrected | 4. The invalid value is not silently accepted, truncated, stripped, or converted | 5. Other limit fields and rows retain their original values
